input.sha256_scope: No image input. Every case is synthetic region and block specs written out in the capture tool; the expected file is both the input record and the expected record.

upstream.capture_method: Real LayoutBlock and LayoutRegion objects were constructed from seven synthetic multi-region pages, the page box was unioned with update_region_box, and xycut_enhanced was executed twice as sort_layout_parsing_blocks does: once over the page of regions, then inside each ordered region. The recorded values are each region's derived direction, text-line means, and euclidean distance, the region order, and the flattened (region, block) order.

limitations: Regions are synthetic axis-aligned specs, not model detections; the region detection model itself is exercised by the later end-to-end slice.
Every region is non-empty: get_layout_parsing_objects silently drops a detected region whose block list is empty, so an empty region never reaches the ordering.
The euclidean distance is recorded at construction time and never refreshed, matching upstream's single update_euclidean_distance call.
